title: Maple Play: Senses & Little Hands
brands: Play for Maple at 8 months: putting in and taking out, pincer practice, cause and effect, mess-free paint, busy boards, sounds and gentle looking games. Always supervised; nothing small enough to choke on
Household help for Max, Nozomi and Maple. Fresh picks only: nothing repeats an earlier Household deck or the board's Jakarta trip cards.
